label: late original-phase steps in long sequences opening with c/o/u/2/3 (weak, conjunctive)
explanation: Very sparse (0.005% of steps) and weak (max 0.26). 94% of mass is in the original phase at the last or second-to-last original token (to_go<=1, orig_idx 6-8), mostly in L=8-9 sequences. It never fires at t<4 and almost never during copy (only recall_idx 0-1, about 3% of mass). Activations are concentrated in sequences whose first tokens are c/o/u followed by c/2/3/u/o, and the current input tends to be w/y/0/1/h. No single predicate isolates it: the context condition alone (late original step, 2+ of the first 3 tokens in {c,o,u,2,3}) covers 74% of mass at 0.8% precision, and the best conjunction reaches only about 5% precision and 37% recall (dev F1 0.095). It looks like a direction in the hidden state that depends on the combination of several early tokens, not on any one variable. Magnitude rises slightly with later position (top quartile coverage is higher), but nothing found predicts magnitude reliably.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig1=c (+4.27), orig0=c (+3.78), orig1=2 (+3.21), orig0=o (+3.14), orig2=2 (+2.88), orig2=v (+2.72). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-3.59), next_out=- (-3.25), prev3_tok=- (-1.98), t=3 (-1.56).
